16:13 Local Time, 15:13 GMT, 20:43 IST: Sri Lanka would be happy but I think there would be a feeling in their camp they could have pushed beyond 340. Mendis set it up with a hundred. Kamindu also got a fifty. And Rathnayake also played a fine hand but that final dash was missing. The last 10 overs went for 84 runs as England did manage to execute their plans well. Rehan Ahmed bowled a few vital overs at the death to ensure Lanka didn't get away. England would feel they could fielded better. The odd ball was stopping a little and England need to be a little careful about it. But it is still a flat track and England would back themselves. Lanka would want some magic with the ball.
